# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash-low-delivery-timing

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

50-pair `flash` confirmation run of **Message Delivery Timing** (selected automatically as the winning `gemini-3-flash-preview` intervention across `flash_10` + `core`) on `vertex_ai/gemini-3-flash-preview` (`low` thinking, 100 steps, compaction at 28K, per-turn step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap). Buffers non-blocking incoming messages up to 4 steps until a natural workflow boundary (passing test, git, or pull-request command, messaging turn, or exploration-to-editing transition). Compared directly against `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash-low-stepcounter` (16/50).

## Observations

- Passed **23/50 (46.0%)**, a **+14.0 percentage-point (+43.8% relative) improvement** over the 16/50 (32.0%) `coop --git` baseline at identical cost (`$19.60` vs. `$19.72`), identical wall time (31 min), and **0 API retries** at 6.83M input tokens/min peak load.
- Clean-merge passes (`clean` or `identical`) jumped by the exact same margin from **13/50 (26.0%) to 20/50 (40.0%, +14.0 percentage points)**, while merge conflicts fell from 24 to 20 (and `missing_input` patches fell from 1 to 0).
- Paired comparison across all 50 pairs shows **10 fail-to-pass wins vs. only 3 pass-to-fail losses** overall (and **9 wins vs. 2 losses** on clean-merge passes), with clean-merge recoveries spanning 6 repositories (`dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1655` (7,10), `openai_tiktoken_task/0` (3,6), `pallets_click_task/2800` (1,7), `pallets_jinja_task/1465` (2,3), `pallets_jinja_task/1559` (4,8), `pallets_jinja_task/1621` (1,6) and (6,7), and `pillow_task/25` (1,5)).
